
```{r}
output <- "Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/03_dea/TwoCell-Basemodel_pat_mother/"
```

TF target enrichment analysis via Enrichr (https://maayanlab.cloud/Enrichr/). Use tables generated with DEA function to select gene names of differentially expressed genes and the background (total genome).
Download results from ChEA 2022 database enrichment analysis. Load in resulting df for plotting.
```{r}
df <- read.delim(paste0(output, "ChEA_pat_table.txt"), header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

df$TF <- sub(" .*", "", df$Term)

# Compute -log10(p) for y-axis
df$log_padj <- -log10(df$Adjusted.P.value)  # replace with correct column if needed

top_tfs <- df %>%
  arrange(desc(log_padj)) %>%
  slice_head(n = nrow(df[df$Adjusted.P.value < 0.05,]))  # or use more if desired

thres.fdr <- -log10(0.05)

tf_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Odds.Ratio, y = log_padj)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = thres.fdr, linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey40") +
  geom_point(color = "grey70", size = 1.5) +  
  geom_point(data = top_tfs, aes(x = Odds.Ratio, y = log_padj), color = "#1e85d9", size = 2) +  # highlight
  geom_text_repel(data = top_tfs,
                  aes(label = TF),
                  size = 2, 
                  box.padding = 0.3,
                  point.padding = 0.2,
                  max.overlaps = 15) +
  xlim(0,6) +
  ylim(0,30) + 
  labs(x = "Odds ratio", y = expression(-log[10](adj.p-value))) +
  theme_cowplot(font_size = 8, line_size = 0.5)

ggsave("TF_enrichr_plot.pdf", plot = tf_plot, path=output, width = 4, height = 4.5, units = "cm")
```

Load results from analysis in spermRNA and embryoRNA maternal transcriptome
```{r}
se.sperm <- readRDS("Steg2026/SpermRNA/results/03_dea/B6-F0-Male-Basemodel_EmbryoSamples/SE.rds")

se.twocell.mat <- readRDS("Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/03_dea/TwoCell-Basemodel_mat_mother/SE.rds")
```

Take differentially expressed genes in paternal transcriptome and subset for genes detected in all three analyses
```{r}
res.sperm <- as.data.frame(rowData(se.sperm))
res.twocell.pat <- as.data.frame(rowData(se.twocell.pat))
res.twocell.mat <- as.data.frame(rowData(se.twocell.mat))

data.overlap <- res.twocell.pat[res.twocell.pat %in% rownames(se.sperm) & res.twocell.pat %in% rownames(se.twocell.mat)]
```

Identify genes that are consistently up or down in sperm and 2cell paternal
```{r}
logfc_matrix_sperm2pat <- data.frame(
  Sperm = res.sperm[data.overlap, "dea.logFC"],
  TwoCell = res.twocell.pat[data.overlap, "dea.logFC"],
  row.names = data.overlap
)
# Subset for genes with all positive logFCs
logfc_up <- logfc_matrix_sperm2pat[apply(logfc_matrix_sperm2pat, 1, function(x) all(x > 0.5)), ]

# Subset for genes with all negative logFCs
logfc_down <- logfc_matrix_sperm2pat[apply(logfc_matrix_sperm2pat, 1, function(x) all(x < -0.5)), ]

Sperm2EmbryoGenes <- rbind(logfc_up, logfc_down)

write.csv(Sperm2EmbryoGenes, file = "Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/04_sperm_to_embryo/Sperm2EmbryoGenes.csv")
```

Plot heatmap with expression of Sperm2EmbryoGenes in sperm, embryo paternal and maternal transcriptome.
```{r}
range_val <- max(abs(logfc_matrix_sperm2pat)) 

logfc_mat <- data.frame(
  Sperm = res.sperm[data.overlap, "dea.logFC"],
  TwoCell.pat = res.twocell.pat[data.overlap, "dea.logFC"],
  TwoCell.mat = res.twocell.mat[data.overlap, "dea.logFC"],
  row.names = data.overlap
)

logfc_mat <- logfc_mat[rownames(Sperm2EmbryoGenes),]

# Plot
sperm2embryo.heatmap <- pheatmap(logfc_mat, 
         cluster_rows = FALSE, 
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         show_rownames = F,
         fontsize = 7,
         scale = "column",           # or "row" to z-score per gene
         color = colorRampPalette(c("#761111", "white", "#114476"))(100),
         breaks = seq(-range_val, range_val, length.out = 101),
         main = "logFC heatmap of 2cell DEA top genes")


pdf(file = "Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/04_sperm_to_embryo/Sperm2EmbryoHeatmap.pdf", width = 2.5,height = 2.5)
sperm2embryo.heatmap
dev.off()
```

Analysis to find overlapping most expressed transcripts of Sperm2Embryo genes in both sperm and paternal transcriptome of twocell embryo
Step 1: Create count matrix of transcripts in both datasets

```{bash engine.opts='-l', eval=F}
python Steg2026/scripts/CreateCounts1.py Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/01_preprocess/15_salmon_post_snpsplit/genome1/*_quant/quant.sf Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/01_preprocess/15_salmon_post_snpsplit/genome1/count_matrix.tsv

python Steg2026/scripts/CreateCounts1.py Steg2026/SpermRNA/results/01_preprocess/12_salmon_post_dedup/*_quant/quant.sf Steg2026/SpermRNA/results/01_preprocess/12_salmon_post_dedup/count_matrix.tsv
```

Load tables and annotation, find most expressed transcripts per gene in both datasets, calculate proportion and plot.
```{r}
# Load in Twocell paternal transcript count matrix
counts.trx.pat <- read.table(
  "Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/01_preprocess/15_salmon_post_snpsplit/genome1/count_matrix.tsv",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Load in sperm transcript count matrix
counts.trx.sperm <- read.table(
  "Steg2026/SpermRNA/results/01_preprocess/12_salmon_post_dedup/count_matrix.tsv",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Subset for samples of fathers used for IVF
samples.NOT.embryo.fathers <- c("B6-F0-03", "B6-F0-06", "B6-F0-09", "B6-F0-20", "B6-F0-25", "B6-F0-38", "B6-F0-61", "B6-F0-64")
counts.trx.sperm <- counts.trx.sperm[,!(colnames(counts.trx.sperm) %in% samples.NOT.embryo.fathers)]

# Load annotation files
txdb <- TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene
# Extract all the transcript names (TXNAME) as keys
k <- keys(txdb, keytype = "TXNAME")
# Create a mapping (tx2gene) from TXNAME (transcript IDs) to GENEID (UCSC Entrez IDs)
tx2gene <- AnnotationDbi::select(txdb, keys = k, columns = "GENEID", keytype = "TXNAME")
# Use org.Mm.eg.db to map UCSC Entrez IDs to Ensembl Gene IDs
ensembl_map <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, 
                      keys = tx2gene$GENEID, 
                      column = "SYMBOL", 
                      keytype = "ENTREZID", 
                      multiVals = "first") 

tx2gene$NAME <- as.character(ensembl_map[tx2gene$GENEID])
tx2gene <- tx2gene[!is.na(tx2gene$GENEID),]

# Create dataframe with most expressed transcripts in each dataset per Sperm2Embryo gene
colnames.df <- c("SpermMostUsed", "%Sperm", "EmbryoMostUsed", "%Embryo", "Overlap", "InTop3", "%inTop3", "InTop3AndHigh")

Sperm2Embryo.trxs <- as.data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(Sperm2EmbryoGenes), 
                                          ncol = length(colnames.df), 
                                          dimnames = list(rownames(Sperm2EmbryoGenes), colnames.df)))

for (i in 1:nrow(Sperm2EmbryoGenes)) {
  
  gene <- rownames(Sperm2EmbryoGenes)[i]
  
  trxs <- tx2gene[tx2gene$NAME == gene,]$TXNAME
  trxs <- trxs[!is.na(trxs)]
  
  if (length(trxs > 1)) {
    sperm.sub <- counts.trx.sperm[trxs,]
    sperm.sub.sums <- rowSums(sperm.sub)
    sperm.sub.sums <- sperm.sub.sums[!is.na(sperm.sub.sums)]
    sperm.most.trx <- names(sperm.sub.sums[sperm.sub.sums == max(sperm.sub.sums)])
    sperm.top3.trx <- names(sperm.sub.sums[order(sperm.sub.sums, decreasing = T)][1:3])
    
    embryo.sub <- counts.trx.pat[trxs,]
    embryo.sub.sums <- rowSums(embryo.sub)
    embryo.sub.sums <- embryo.sub.sums[!is.na(embryo.sub.sums)]
    embryo.most.trx <- names(embryo.sub.sums[embryo.sub.sums == max(embryo.sub.sums)])
    
    Sperm2Embryo.trxs[i,]$SpermMostUsed <- sperm.most.trx
    Sperm2Embryo.trxs[i,]$`%Sperm` <- max(sperm.sub.sums)/sum(sperm.sub.sums)
    
    Sperm2Embryo.trxs[i,]$EmbryoMostUsed <- embryo.most.trx
    Sperm2Embryo.trxs[i,]$`%Embryo` <- max(embryo.sub.sums)/sum(embryo.sub.sums)
    
    Sperm2Embryo.trxs[i,]$Overlap <- embryo.most.trx == sperm.most.trx
    Sperm2Embryo.trxs[i,]$InTop3 <- embryo.most.trx %in% sperm.top3.trx
    Sperm2Embryo.trxs[i,]$`%inTop3` <- sperm.sub.sums[embryo.most.trx]/sum(sperm.sub.sums)
    
    Sperm2Embryo.trxs[i,]$InTop3AndHigh <- Sperm2Embryo.trxs[i,]$InTop3 == T & Sperm2Embryo.trxs[i,]$`%inTop3` > 0.4
    
  }
}

Sperm2Embryo.trxs <- Sperm2Embryo.trxs[complete.cases(Sperm2Embryo.trxs),]

# Proportion of genes that have the same transcript
prop.sperm2embryo.trxs.overlap <- sum(Sperm2Embryo.trxs$Overlap)/nrow(Sperm2Embryo.trxs)
# 0.5875486

# Plot barplot
df <- tibble(
  category = c("Shared most expressed transcript", "Different transcript"),
  proportion = c(
    prop.sperm2embryo.trxs.overlap,
    1 - prop.sperm2embryo.trxs.overlap
  )
)

barplot.trxs <- ggplot(df, aes(x = "", y = proportion, fill = category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Shared most expressed transcript" = "#5A7B9C",
      "Different transcript" = "#B3B3B3"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentage of genes",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_cowplot(font_size = 8)


ggsave(filename = "barplot.overlap.trxs.pdf", plot = barplot.trxs,path = "Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/04_sperm_to_embryo/", width = 7, height = 4, units = "cm")
```


Intron retention and transcript integrity of Sperm2Embryo genes in sperm and in the paternal transcriptome of two-cell embryos.
Load Sperm2Embryo genes
```{r}
gene_list <- read.csv("Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/04_sperm_to_embryo/Sperm2EmbryoGenes.csv")$X
```

Intron retention analysis with IRFinder-S.
IRFinder-S was run on paternal (genome1) and maternal (genome2) reads of two-cell embryos with Snakefile_IRFinder, and on sperm reads with the SpermRNA workflow.
Load IRFinder matrices of two-cell embryos and run analysis on the paternal transcriptome
```{r}
# Load embryo matrices
IRratio <- fread("Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/01_preprocess/23_irfinder/irfinder_matrix_IRratio.txt")
IntronDepth <- fread("Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/01_preprocess/23_irfinder/irfinder_matrix_IntronDepth.txt")

# Create rowData with gene names and intron type
rowData_embryo <- IRratio[, 1:5]
rowData_embryo[, gene := tstrsplit(Name, "/")[[1]]]
rowData_embryo[, intron_type := tstrsplit(Name, "/")[[3]]]

# Create matrices with row IDs
row_ids <- paste(rowData_embryo$Chr, rowData_embryo$Start, rowData_embryo$End,
                 rowData_embryo$Name, rowData_embryo$Strand, sep = "_")
mat_IRratio <- as.matrix(IRratio[, 6:ncol(IRratio)])
mat_IntronDepth <- as.matrix(IntronDepth[, 6:ncol(IntronDepth)])
rownames(mat_IRratio) <- row_ids
rownames(mat_IntronDepth) <- row_ids

# Subset for paternal transcriptome (genome1)
twocell_genome1_cols <- grep("TwoCell.*genome1", colnames(mat_IRratio), value = TRUE)

mat_IRratio_input <- mat_IRratio[, twocell_genome1_cols]
mat_IntronDepth_input <- mat_IntronDepth[, twocell_genome1_cols]

# Load function
source("Steg2026/scripts/run_irfinder_analysis.R")

# Run analysis
result_embryo_g1 <- run_irfinder_analysis(
  mat_IRratio     = mat_IRratio_input,
  mat_IntronDepth = mat_IntronDepth_input,
  rowData         = rowData_embryo,
  gene_list       = gene_list,
  min_samples     = 3,
  min_depth       = 5
)

# Extract candidate and background IRratios
candidate_g1 <- result_embryo_g1$candidate_IR
background_g1 <- result_embryo_g1$background_IR

cat("Embryo genome1 - Candidate median:", median(candidate_g1), "\n")
cat("Embryo genome1 - Background median:", median(background_g1), "\n")
cat("p-value:", result_embryo_g1$p_value, "\n")
```

Load IRFinder matrices of sperm and run analysis with the same thresholds
```{r}

sperm_IRratio <- fread("Steg2026/SpermRNA/results/01_preprocess/21_irfinder/irfinder_matrix_IRratio.txt")
sperm_IntronDepth <- fread("Steg2026/SpermRNA/results/01_preprocess/21_irfinder/irfinder_matrix_IntronDepth.txt")

# Create rowData with gene names and intron type

rowData_sperm[, gene := tstrsplit(Name, "/")[[1]]]
rowData_sperm[, intron_type := tstrsplit(Name, "/")[[3]]]

mat_IntronDepth_sperm <- as.matrix(sperm_IntronDepth[, 6:ncol(sperm_IntronDepth)])
rownames(mat_IRratio_sperm) <- row_ids_sperm
rownames(mat_IntronDepth_sperm) <- row_ids_sperm

cat("Sperm - Background median:", median(background_sperm), "\n")
cat("p-value:", result_sperm$p_value, "\n")
```

Plot intron retention as violin plots
```{r}
# Combine embryo and sperm results
plot_df <- data.frame(
    IRratio = c(candidate_g1, background_g1,
                candidate_sperm, background_sperm),
    Group = c(rep("Candidate", length(candidate_g1)),
              rep("Background", length(background_g1)),
              rep("Candidate", length(candidate_sperm)),
              rep("Background", length(background_sperm))),
    Dataset = c(rep("Embryo genome1\n(paternal)", length(candidate_g1) + length(background_g1)),
                rep("Sperm", length(candidate_sperm) + length(background_sperm)))
)

plot_df$Group <- factor(plot_df$Group, levels = c("Background", "Candidate"))
plot_df$Dataset <- factor(plot_df$Dataset, levels = c("Sperm", "Embryo genome1\n(paternal)"))

# Plot
p_violin <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Group, y = IRratio, fill = Group)) +
    geom_violin(trim = F, bounds = c(0,1)) +
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, fatten = 2, color = "black") +
    facet_wrap(~Dataset) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                       label = "p.format",
                       label.x = 1.5,
                       label.y = 0.95) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Background" = "#B3B3B3", "Candidate" = "#5A7B9C")) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    theme_cowplot(font_size = 8) +
    theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 7)
    ) +
    labs(
        title = "Intron Retention in Candidate vs Background Genes",
        x = "",
        y = "Mean IRratio per gene"
    )

ggsave(filename = "irfinder_violin.pdf", plot = p_violin, path = "Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/04_sperm_to_embryo/", width = 9, height = 5, units = "cm")
```

Transcript integrity analysis.
TIN scores were calculated on paternal (genome1) reads of two-cell embryos with Snakefile_IRFinder, and on sperm reads with the SpermRNA workflow.
Load TIN scores of the paternal transcriptome of two-cell embryos and map transcripts to gene names
```{r}
# Load genome1 TIN matrix
tin_g1 <- read.table("Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/01_preprocess/24_genebody_coverage/merged_genome1.tin.tsv",
                     header = TRUE, sep = "\t", row.names = 1)
cat("Dimensions:", nrow(tin_g1), "x", ncol(tin_g1), "\n")

# Strip version numbers for BioMart query
tin_ids <- gsub("\\..*", "", rownames(tin_g1))

# Map transcript IDs to gene names with BioMart
mart <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl")

tx_map <- getBM(
    attributes = c("ensembl_transcript_id", "external_gene_name"),
    filters    = "ensembl_transcript_id",
    values     = tin_ids,
    mart       = mart
)

# Build mapping dataframe
tx_map$ensembl_transcript_id_versioned <- rownames(tin_g1)[match(tx_map$ensembl_transcript_id, tin_ids)]
tx_map <- tx_map[tx_map$external_gene_name != "", ]
colnames(tx_map) <- c("transcript_id", "gene_name", "transcript_id_versioned")

cat("Transcripts:", nrow(tx_map), "\n")
cat("Unique genes:", length(unique(tx_map$gene_name)), "\n")
cat("Sperm2Embryo transcripts:", sum(tx_map$gene_name %in% gene_list), "\n")
cat("Sperm2Embryo genes covered:", length(unique(tx_map$gene_name[tx_map$gene_name %in% gene_list])), "\n")
```

Filter lowly expressed transcripts and calculate median TIN per transcript in two-cell embryos
```{r}
# Subset TIN matrix for mapped transcripts
tin_g1_mapped <- tin_g1[tx_map$transcript_id_versioned, ]
tin_g1_mapped$gene_name <- tx_map$gene_name
tin_g1_mapped$is_GOI    <- tx_map$gene_name %in% gene_list

# Keep transcripts with TIN > 0 in at least 10% of samples
twocell_cols <- grep("TwoCell", colnames(tin_g1_mapped), value = TRUE)

tin_values  <- tin_g1_mapped[, twocell_cols]
n_expressed <- rowSums(tin_values > 0)
keep        <- n_expressed >= (0.1 * length(twocell_cols))

tin_filtered <- tin_g1_mapped[keep, ]
cat("Sperm2Embryo transcripts:", sum(tin_filtered$is_GOI), "\n")
cat("Background transcripts:", sum(!tin_filtered$is_GOI), "\n")

# Replace 0 with NA and compute median TIN per transcript
tin_values_filtered <- tin_filtered[, twocell_cols]
tin_values_filtered[tin_values_filtered == 0] <- NA
tin_filtered$median_TIN <- apply(tin_values_filtered, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
```

Test and plot TIN scores in two-cell embryos
```{r}
plot_df <- tin_filtered %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_name, is_GOI, median_TIN) %>%
    mutate(group = ifelse(is_GOI, "GOI", "Background"))

wilcox_result <- wilcox.test(median_TIN ~ group, data = plot_df, alternative = "two.sided")

cat("Wilcoxon p-value:", wilcox_result$p.value, "\n")
cat("GOI median TIN:", median(plot_df$median_TIN[plot_df$is_GOI], na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Background median TIN:", median(plot_df$median_TIN[!plot_df$is_GOI], na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

p_embryo_tin <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = group, y = median_TIN, fill = group)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, bounds = c(0,100), alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("GOI" = "#5A7B9C", "Background" = "#B3B3B3")) +
    labs(title    = "TIN scores - TwoCell paternal (genome1)",
         subtitle = paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", signif(wilcox_result$p.value, 3)),
         x        = NULL,
         y        = "Median TIN score",
         fill     = NULL) +
    theme_cowplot(font_size = 8) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(filename = "Embryo.violin.TIN.pdf", plot = p_embryo_tin, path = "Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/04_sperm_to_embryo/", width = 5, height = 5, units = "cm")
```

Load TIN scores of sperm, filter, test and plot with the same settings
```{r}
# Load sperm TIN matrix
tin_sperm <- read.table("Steg2026/SpermRNA/results/01_preprocess/14_TinScore/merged.tsv",
                        header = TRUE, sep = "\t", row.names = 1)
cat("Dimensions:", nrow(tin_sperm), "x", ncol(tin_sperm), "\n")

# Map transcripts with the mapping from above
tin_sperm_mapped <- tin_sperm[tx_map$transcript_id_versioned, ]
tin_sperm_mapped$gene_name <- tx_map$gene_name
tin_sperm_mapped$is_GOI    <- tx_map$gene_name %in% gene_list

# Keep transcripts with TIN > 0 in at least 10% of samples
sperm_cols <- colnames(tin_sperm)
tin_values_sperm <- tin_sperm_mapped[, sperm_cols]
n_expressed_sperm <- rowSums(tin_values_sperm > 0)
keep_sperm <- n_expressed_sperm >= (0.10 * length(sperm_cols))

tin_filtered_sperm <- tin_sperm_mapped[keep_sperm, ]
cat("Sperm2Embryo transcripts:", sum(tin_filtered_sperm$is_GOI), "\n")
cat("Background transcripts:", sum(!tin_filtered_sperm$is_GOI), "\n")

# Replace 0 with NA and compute median TIN per transcript
tin_values_filtered_sperm <- tin_filtered_sperm[, sperm_cols]
tin_values_filtered_sperm[tin_values_filtered_sperm == 0] <- NA
tin_filtered_sperm$median_TIN <- apply(tin_values_filtered_sperm, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)

# Test and plot
plot_df_sperm <- tin_filtered_sperm %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_name, is_GOI, median_TIN) %>%
    mutate(group = ifelse(is_GOI, "GOI", "Background"))

wilcox_sperm <- wilcox.test(median_TIN ~ group, data = plot_df_sperm, alternative = "two.sided")

cat("Sperm Wilcoxon p-value:", wilcox_sperm$p.value, "\n")
cat("GOI median TIN:", median(plot_df_sperm$median_TIN[plot_df_sperm$is_GOI], na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Background median TIN:", median(plot_df_sperm$median_TIN[!plot_df_sperm$is_GOI], na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

p_sperm_tin <- ggplot(plot_df_sperm, aes(x = group, y = median_TIN, fill = group)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, bounds = c(0,100), alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("GOI" = "#5A7B9C", "Background" = "#B3B3B3")) +
    labs(title    = "TIN scores - Sperm",
         subtitle = paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", signif(wilcox_sperm$p.value, 3)),
         x        = NULL,
         y        = "Median TIN score",
         fill     = NULL) +
    theme_cowplot(font_size = 8) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(filename = "Sperm.violin.TIN.pdf", plot = p_sperm_tin, path = "Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/04_sperm_to_embryo/", width = 5, height = 5, units = "cm")
```



Create .bed files at TSS of Sperm2Embryo Genes
```{r}
# Find the Entrez ID for each of the sperm to embryo genes
Sperm2EmbryoGenes$Entrez <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db,
                                           keys = rownames(Sperm2EmbryoGenes),
                                           keytype = "SYMBOL",
                                           column = "ENTREZID",
                                           multiVals = "first")

# Load in txdb for mm10
txdb <- TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene
tx_by_gene <- transcriptsBy(txdb, by = "gene")

genes <- genes(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene)

# Prepare output and seed
output <- "Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/04_sperm_to_embryo/"

set.seed(123)

# Bed for Sperm to Embryo genes
genes.merged <- genes[names(genes) %in% unname(Sperm2EmbryoGenes$Entrez) ]
genes.tss.merged <- resize(genes.merged, width = 1, fix = "start") 
export.bed(genes.tss.merged, con = paste0(output,"genes.tss.merged.bed"))

# Bed for random background take genes expressed in early 2 cell embryo
SE.embryo<- readRDS("Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/03_dea/TwoCell-Basemodel_dedup_mother/SE.rds")
res.embryo <- as.data.frame(rowData(SE.embryo))

res.embryo$Entrez <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db,keys = rownames(res.embryo),keytype = "SYMBOL", column = "ENTREZID",multiVals = "first")

genes.background <- tx_by_gene[names(genes) %in% unname(res.embryo$Entrez)]
genes.tss.background <- resize(genes.background, width = 1, fix = "start") 
export.bed(sample(unlist(genes.tss.background), size = nrow(Sperm2EmbryoGenes)), con = paste0(output,"genes.tss.background.bed"))
```

Heatmap with CG content around Sperm2Embryo genes
```{bash engine.opts='-l', eval=F}
# Calcuate CG content in 10 bp windows across the genome
bedtools makewindows -g mm10.chrom.sizes -w 10 \
| bedtools nuc -fi Steg2026/references/genomes/mm10_raw/mm10.fa -bed - \
| awk '{ if (NF<5) next; cg=$5; if (cg>1) cg/=100.0; printf "%s\t%d\t%d\t%.6f\n",$1,$2,$3,cg }' \
| sort -k1,1 -k2,2n -T ./ \
> mm10_GC.bedGraph

# Convert .bedGraph file to .bw file
TMPDIR=./ bedGraphToBigWig Steg2026/references/mm10_GC.bedGraph Steg2026/references/mm10.chrom.sizes Steg2026/references/mm10_GC.bw
```
